regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing leadership structure: AI Infrastructure leads with modest durability (0.5, 'mixed' Hurst) and very poor breadth (0.125), challenged by US Energy Complex which has far superior breadth (0.64) and comparable score. The absolute-trend gate has validated drawdown-control value on this market's history, so eligibility is a meaningful risk filter, but cross-sectional rank carries no alpha. Rotation is not one-narrative (absorption 0.31), and the broadening/narrowing view is 'narrowing' with only 45% of themes eligible — a risk-off texture favoring staying with high-durability, eligible names rather than reaching for low-ranked rebuilds.
emerging_watch: Watching AI Infrastructure leadership for a confirmed handoff to US Energy Complex: if the AI Infra durability bar drops below 0.5 AND breadth stays below 0.2 while Energy Complex holds breadth above 0.6 for two consecutive weekly prints, that would confirm a leadership rotation worth acting on (currently only challenger status, margin 0.185).

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy is the strongest trend-following candidate among the top ranks: eligible (passes the one validated gate), highest non-leader durability (0.62) AND the widest breadth of the top-3 (0.636 vs 0.125 for AI Infra and 0.6 for Cyber). Narrowing rotation breadth and falling absorption reward the theme with durable participation over the crowded, narrow leader. This is a relative-participation lean, not a rank forecast.
evidence: durability_bar=0.62, second highest among top ranks
rotation leader energy_complex score 1.375, challenger to AI Infra
theses.dissent: Energy leadership is cliché late-cycle and often coincides with supply-shock headlines (macro_narrative unscheduled_share=0.75 is high). The detector's rank itself has no forward edge, and XLE as a proxy captures cap-weighted majors that may lag the equal-weight energy theme (rank 4, different profile).

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by 5% or more within the 20-day window

theses.subject: Managed Care & Insurers
theses.thesis: Despite a high durability bar (0.81) and strong breadth (0.778), this theme scores negative rank momentum (-0.08) and is flagged crowded (crowding_z=1.11). Crowding is a size-down caution, not a fade, so the honest expression is AVOID: no alpha signal, elevated crowding risk, and no trend-gate edge to compensate. Not a short-capable read either.
theses.dissent: The high durability and breadth could mean managed care is resilient if risk-off deepens, and crowding may persist in trend regimes (reflexivity). But there is no trend-gate or momentum justification to hold it here.

falsifier.text: XLV (healthcare proxy) outperforms SPY by 5% and managed care breadth stays above 0.7 for the full window

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: The leader's durability is only at the bar (0.5) with 'mixed' Hurst and extremely narrow breadth (0.125). With rotation view 'narrowing' and absorption low, a leader with no participation base is a concentration risk with no validated forward edge from rank. Avoid is the disciplined expression for a rank leader that fails the breadth/durability quality screen — not a fade, just no overweight.
evidence: crowding_z=0.15 (not crowded, but no support either)
theses.dissent: AI Infra could re-accelerate on a headline catalyst (macro ai_tech theme present), and being rank-1 with gate-eligible status means it is not broken — just unproven on breadth. Reflexivity can keep a leader leading.

falsifier.text: SMH gains 5% or more against SPY while AI Infra breadth recovers above 0.35 within 20 days

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
